desc: The FT34 LRF is a multi purpose thermal imaging clip on with a laser rangefinder. Features multi (6) reticle with Red/White/Yellow/Green dot Reticle colors; City/Rain/Forest Scene modes and White, Black, Red, In Hot/Edge/Sky Image modes; PIP; gyroscope; self-motivated recording; wireless capable; loop recording; E-compass and shutter. The laser rangefinder features a detection range of 1200yds and a Ballistic calculator. Compatible with the PardVision app.
